answer.rationale: Write path latency spike with settlement peak and immovable security patch rules out rollback. Regional failover (memory_b2) is higher risk when the issue is write congestion, not regional failure. Circuit breaker (memory_b4) doesn't address capacity. Add_capacity requires provisioning time we don't have. Routing read traffic away from primary (memory_b5) has proven fast deployment on day 55 with same-day transactional latency recovery, directly addressing write path congestion during peak load without touching the release. This preserves the security patch requirement while creating headroom for settlement writes.
